node.title: Incertidumbre crítica
node.summary: A missing distinction can prevent a decision even when other facts are known.

relations: Portfolio confidence should preserve unresolved critical dependencies rather than average them away across units.
No se afirma que Richemont usara EA. Antes de agregar, hay que declarar qué incertidumbre afecta a qué decisión y si los dominios son dependientes.
Before rationalizing a portfolio, distinguish a known assessable reserve from a grounded exploration route and from a currently ineffective evaluation route.
Las letras son relativas a actor, proceso y pregunta; no son una taxonomía objetiva y universal de aplicaciones.
